result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a sidewalk in good condition on the residential corner. While a traffic signal controls vehicle flow, there are no visible dedicated pedestrian signals or curb extensions to enhance safety and reduce crossing distance.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal head is visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not account for pedestrian clearance intervals.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Extensions
hazards.description: The absence of bulb-outs increases the unprotected crossing distance and allows for higher vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Reprogram the signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a two-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and curb ramps. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals at the signalized intersection and the wide, straight road geometry may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: A traffic signal is present for vehicles, but no corresponding pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the traffic light pole.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross both lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signal heads and push buttons to provide clear right-of-way for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and signalized traffic control adjacent to a stone church. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the roadway surface shows signs of degradation and lacks dedicated bicycle facilities.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and sealant repairs in the roadway surface which can create uneven footing for pedestrians or hazards for cyclists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signalization
hazards.description: While traffic lights are present, dedicated pedestrian signal heads are not clearly visible, potentially leading to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to turning motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked pavement to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalk markings and a dedicated pedestrian signal, providing a basic level of protection. However, the crossing distance is relatively wide without a refuge island, and there is visible pavement degradation within the crosswalk area.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the marked crosswalk area could present a minor trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, within the crosswalk markings.
